result.instructions: ArduPilot vehicle over MAVLink behind a geofence. Read get_state and get_nav_health before acting; commands outside the fence or altitude band come back with rejected=true.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Vehicle snapshot: position (lat/lon WGS84 deg, alt_msl_m, rel_alt_m above home), local NED position (m from EKF origin), heading (deg true), groundspeed (m/s), flight mode, armed, EKF flags decoded, GPS fix type / satellites / HDOP, battery (V, %), home, the last EKF source set this server commanded, recent STATUSTEXT messages, and the active geofence.

tools.name: get_nav_health
tools.description: Navigation integrity summary from EKF_STATUS_REPORT and GPS_RAW_INT: verdict nominal | degraded | lost | unknown with reasons, gnss_ok, horizontal_position abs | rel | none, EKF variances (normalized test ratios; >=0.5 warn, >=0.8 bad). Use it to decide whether to switch EKF source set or return. Indicators only: not a certified protection level.

tools.name: arm_takeoff
tools.description: Switch to GUIDED, arm (retries while pre-arm checks fail, up to 60 s) and take off to rel_alt_m metres above home. Rejected outside the altitude band or if home is outside the geofence. With wait=true returns after reaching 90% of the altitude (or a 45 s timeout).

tools.name: goto
tools.description: Fly to a point in GUIDED mode (SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT, position only). lat/lon are WGS84 decimal degrees; rel_alt_m is metres above the home position (MAV_FRAME_GLOBAL_RELATIVE_ALT_INT), not above sea level or terrain. Rejected unless the target is inside the geofence (with margin), the straight path from the current position stays inside, and the altitude is within the band. wait_s > 0 blocks until within 3 m or the timeout; otherwise returns at once.

tools.name: set_mode
tools.description: Change ArduCopter flight mode. Allowed: GUIDED, AUTO, LOITER, BRAKE, RTL, LAND, SMART_RTL. AUTO is rejected unless a mission uploaded by this server passed the fence check. RTL/LAND/BRAKE/LOITER are always allowed as exits.

tools.name: upload_mission
tools.description: Validate and upload a waypoint mission (MISSION_ITEM_INT, lat/lon are WGS84 decimal degrees; rel_alt_m is metres above the home position (MAV_FRAME_GLOBAL_RELATIVE_ALT_INT), not above sea level or terrain.) Every waypoint and every leg, starting from the vehicle position, must stay inside the geofence and altitude band. Appends RTL when rtl_at_end. start=true switches to AUTO (vehicle must already be airborne: the mission has no takeoff item).

tools.name: plan_survey
tools.description: Compute (do not upload) a lawnmower survey over a polygon: passes along heading_deg (deg true) spaced spacing_m metres apart at rel_alt_m above home, inset from the polygon edge. polygon is a list of [lat, lon]; omit it to survey the geofence itself. Returns waypoints already checked against the fence, ready for upload_mission.

tools.name: set_ekf_source_set
tools.description: Select ArduPilot EKF3 source set 1, 2 or 3 (MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET). Each set is defined by EK3_SRCn_POSXY/VELXY/POSZ/VELZ/YAW parameters; the result lists what the chosen set uses (e.g. 3=GPS, 6=ExternalNav/vision, 5=OpticalFlow). Switching to a set whose sensors are not producing data will make the EKF lose position.
